title: Board Governance Cycle
description: The routine seat-rotation cycle a board runs on, and the separate trigger a founder's departure fires.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Establishing an Oversight Board and Inventory System

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a board's current state, the learner differentiates the routine seat-rotation cycle from the one-time succession-plan trigger that a founder's departure activates.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin cycle with a term-limit loop plus a separate departure trigger
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which part of the diagram runs every year and which runs once, and what fires each.
